video_title: EXCLUSIVE: Collin Sexton is a DAWG, on Building Team Chemistry - Mason & Ireland at Lakers Media Day

quotes.speaker: Collin Sexton
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Sexton on why he chose to join the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I feel like I'm a competitor. I feel like an opportunity to come in and have a huge role
quotes.quote: It's a big stage. It's the biggest stage. I would say it's one of the teams that you know everybody is going to give you their best shot night in and night out and I feel like I'm a competitor. I feel like an opportunity to come in and have a huge role on this team was something that I wanted and I feel like I'm ready to compete. I think most guys might shy away from it, but me, I've been willing to fight and push myself in any way possible.

quotes.speaker: Collin Sexton
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Sexton on the team's chemistry and off-court bonding
quotes.excerpt: having different experiences together allows us to to gel off the court, so when it's on the court then it's easy
quotes.quote: I think we're coming together a lot better than a lot of people think just because of the simple fact that we've been here together. We've been working together, we've been hanging out together, even outside of here in LA, going to Topgolf, going to real golf, and going to eat dinner, just different things, going to concerts together. Just having different experiences together allows us to to gel off the court, so when it's on the court then it's easy. It just flows. I got to have my teammates back. I got to make this one more pass for him to knock a open shot down or feed the hot guy.

quotes.speaker: Collin Sexton
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Sexton on his chemistry with teammates Walker, Vandal, and Sandro
quotes.excerpt: Me, Walker and Vandal, we've played together, so we have really good chemistry
quotes.quote: Me, Walker and Vandal, we've played together, so we have really good chemistry. But I would say me, Sandro and Quinton. Sandro for sure, because he plays a lot of that pick and pop, the roll action and that flip back action of him shooting the ball. So me and Sandro, and we like some of the same similar things and he's one of those people that he's very fun to be around and he's a great person.

quotes.speaker: Collin Sexton
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Sexton on his close relationship with teammate Mamukelashvili
quotes.excerpt: He's one of those people that I feel like I'm a grow even closer to as the season goes on
quotes.quote: He's one of those people that he loves to laugh, joke, he loves good food, so we always come in each and every day, okay, so what new restaurant did you try out this week? So we're pretty much like that and he's one of those people that I feel like I'm a grow even closer to as the season goes on.

quotes.speaker: Collin Sexton
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Sexton on which teammate could host Saturday Night Live
quotes.excerpt: I think AR can do it. He's definitely funny
quotes.quote: I think AR can do it. I think AR can do it. He's definitely funny. I would say he's one of those people who makes funny jokes here and there all the time. He's really cool to be around. Him and Luka are very big joksters, so I definitely enjoy being their teammates and just like understanding them off the court because you see them on the court, they are one of those, they are assassins and they are killers on the court, so getting to know them off the court and how much fun they have is pretty cool.
